description: D2's declaration on the wire: `attended` is what `aeon loop start` sends at start (true for a human at a terminal, false for a scripted start nobody will answer) and the daemon pins it beside the blueprint bytes without re-deriving it. The field is OPTIONAL here on purpose: a client that cannot say must send nothing and get never-recorded, never a daemon-supplied guess — the third state is the reason loop-start.json exists unchanged beside this fixture. protogen is fixture-derived, so this file is what puts attended on the app's loop.start params type.
